title: Name 'em All
ogAlt: Name 'em All: how many Pokémon can you name from memory?

hub.metaTitle: Name 'em All: Can You Name Every Pokémon? Recall Quiz
hub.metaDescription: Type every Pokémon you can remember: all of them, a generation, a type, Legendaries, Megas, regional forms or a regional Pokédex. Daily quiz, races with friends and personal bests.
hub.lead: How many Pokémon can you name from memory? Type them in, and each one pops into its slot the moment it's spelled right.

info.description: A free Pokémon recall quiz: name every Pokémon in a category against the clock.
info.intro: Name 'em All is a Pokémon recall quiz: pick a category and type every Pokémon in it from memory. Names count the instant they're spelled right, in any order.

steps.pick: Pick a category: everything, a generation, a type, the Legendaries, Megas, regional forms or a regional Pokédex.
steps.mode: Choose Regular, Chaos or Dex order, a timer and any hints.
steps.type: Type names: each fills its slot as soon as it's spelled right. Capitals, accents and punctuation don't matter.
steps.giveUp: Give up any time to see the ones you missed, each linked to its Pokédex page.

faq.dailyA: Yes: one category a day, the same for everyone. One try a day counts.
faq.raceA: Start a race, share the link, and up to eight trainers name the same category at once with live progress bars.
faq.bestA: Sign in and play in Regular mode without hints or pausing: your fastest full clear and the most you named inside the standard time show on your trainer profile.

steps.pick: Pick a mode, a timer and any hints.
steps.type: Type names: each one fills its slot as soon as it's spelled right.
steps.finish: Name them all before time runs out, or give up to see the ones you missed.

faq.spellQ: Do I need to spell names exactly?
faq.spellA: Capitals, accents, spaces and punctuation don't matter. Turn on the spelling helper to get a suggestion when you're one or two letters off.
faq.bestQ: What counts as a personal best?
faq.bestA: Regular runs without hints or pauses: your fastest full clear and the most you named inside the standard {minutes} minutes, shown on your trainer profile when you're signed in.

daily.metaTitle: Name 'em All Daily: Today's Pokémon Recall Quiz
daily.metaDescription: One Pokémon category a day, the same for everyone: name as many as you can in the standard time and see where you rank today.
